name: nezx-academy
description: NEZX Academy - e-commerce training site, admin inbox and API

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @nezx/shared && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nezx/shared && npm run build -w @nezx/api && npm run build -w @nezx/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nezx/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.setup: npm run build -w @nezx/shared && npm run db:generate -w @nezx/api && npm run db:migrate -w @nezx/api && npm run db:seed -w @nezx/api
